cases.case_label: AluYa5 in ATM intron 54 causing exon 54 skipping (HBOC)
cases.mechanism_detail: An AluYa5 inserted 30 bp downstream of ATM exon 54 causes exon 54 skipping (38% of ATM transcripts in carrier lymphocytes; ~77% of minigene transcripts vs 4.7% for wild type), predicted to cause a frameshift and premature stop. Incomplete penetrance; considered a likely contributor rather than sole cause.
cases.quote: Transcript analysis of patient-derived RNA from three heterozygous carriers revealed exon 54 skipping in 38% of total ATM transcripts.
